subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: Mina said to Rina, “When does your SSC Examination commence?” “It commences in 2nd week of February 2024, ” she said. “Your SSC Examination is knocking at the door and don’t waste your time,” said Mina. “You're right.” said Rina. “And I am learning my lessons with profound attention. Please pray for me.”
guide_solution: Changing the form of speech Mina asked Rina when her (R) SSC Examination would commence. She (R) replied that it would commence in 2nd week of February 2024. Mina told her (R) that her SSC Examination was knocking at the door and forbade her (R) to waste her (R) time. Rina retorted that she (M) was right and added that she (R) was learning her lessons with profound attention. Rina requested her (M) to pray for her (R).
